biggest_catch: This pays in free YNAB subscription time, not cash — and your friend has to actually convert from the free trial to a paid subscription, not just sign up.
catches: Your friend must subscribe (pay for YNAB) after their free trial — a trial signup alone earns nothing.
You must be a current paid YNAB subscriber to earn free time; gift-subscription recipients are excluded unless they have a current paid subscription.
The referral program only applies to subscriptions purchased directly through YNAB or the Google Play store (App Store subscriptions excluded).
Not available to Financial Wellness by YNAB accounts.
Each side gets one free month per subscribing friend; free time pushes back your renewal date.
Reward is subscription credit, not cash — it has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn.

eligibility: Referrer must be a current paid YNAB subscriber (not Financial Wellness accounts, not gift-only accounts). Friend must sign up through your referral link and subscribe (paid) after the free trial. Subscription must be purchased directly through YNAB or the Google Play store.

Reward is subscription time worth one month of YNAB service (YNAB charges monthly/annual; exact dollar value depends on current pricing, so the reward is stated in months). No YNAB route exists in the catalog, so no duplication. steps: As a current YNAB subscriber, find your unique referral link in the 'Love YNAB? Pay it forward' page in the sidebar.
Share the link with a friend.
Your friend signs up for the YNAB free trial through your link.
After the trial, your friend subscribes to YNAB (purchase must be direct through YNAB or Google Play).
Once they subscribe, both you and your friend get an additional free month of YNAB; your renewal date is pushed back one month.
Track earned free months on your Referral Dashboard in Account Settings.
timing: Free month credits when the friend subscribes after the free trial.
